business_problem: Quantiphi needed to consolidate security data spread across multiple clouds because analysts were stuck triaging alerts in isolated dashboards and dealing with severe alert fatigue instead of proactively addressing threats.
solution_summary: Quantiphi modernized its security operations on Google Cloud by consolidating multicloud telemetry into a unified Google SecOps operating model. The company uses Google Security Operations SOAR to create a single data model and automate response workflows, while Google Security Operations (SecOps) provides the centralized threat-detection surface that replaces fragmented native logging systems from multiple clouds. Analysts use Gemini in SecOps to generate correlation rules and SOAR playbooks from natural-language prompts instead of writing them manually, and Mandiant Threat Intelligence adds external threat context to the environment. Together, these components reduce engineering time, cut alert fatigue, and let the security team move toward auto-remediation and self-healing security systems. The resulting platform improves data protection and supports the regulatory trust Quantiphi needs for its global client work.
